description: HushPinterest v0.0.6: 26 patches for Pinterest 14.38.0, which needs Android 10 or newer. New in this release: Download board, Long-press download and Hide survey prompts, and Morphe Manager's default selection now holds every patch but Spoof signature for Google sign-in, with the newly selected switches starting off. On Android 9, stay on the previous release. Validation: 705 runtime tests passed. All 186 patch tests passed. All 26 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.38.0. Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.
